scan.title.context: Heading of the full-screen QR scanner (visible over the camera)

scan.torch.context: Toggle button that switches the phone flashlight on/off while scanning

scan.enterCode.context: Button at the bottom of the scanner that opens manual code entry

scan.invalid.context: Shown when a scanned QR code is not one of our masjid posters; {app} is the app name

scan.found.context: Screen-reader announcement when a masjid QR is detected

scan.permission.allow.context: Button that asks the browser for camera permission

code.title.context: Title of the sheet where the 8-character masjid code is typed

code.label.context: Accessible name of the code input

code.submit.context: Button that looks up the typed code

preview.follow.context: Primary button in the masjid preview: follow this masjid

preview.open.context: Button that opens the masjid page (already followed)

preview.limit.context: Shown when the device already follows the maximum number of masjids; {max} is that number (20)

preview.manage.context: Button that opens the My Masjids tab to unfollow one

preview.followed.context: Toast after following; {name} is the masjid name

landing.title.context: Title of the page opened from a masjid follow link

landing.scanAgain.context: Button on the masjid-not-found page that opens the scanner

landing.iosTitle.context: iPhone Safari page opened from a masjid link: follow it inside the installed app; {app} is the app name

landing.iosBody.context: Followed by the masjid code shown large; quote the scanner button exactly as in scan.enterCode

landing.iosHere.context: Text button: keep using the app inside Safari instead of the installed app

landing.codeLabel.context: Label for the large masjid code shown on the iPhone page

landing.continue.context: Before first-time setup: go on to the app's setup screens from the masjid page
